cachingEnabled.description: This is the flag to toggle voice caching for the assistant.

provider.description: This is the voice provider that will be used.

voiceId.description: This is the provider-specific ID that will be used. Use a voice from MINIMAX_PREDEFINED_VOICES or a custom cloned voice ID.
voiceId.title: This is the Minimax Voice ID

model.description:
This is the model that will be used. Options are 'speech-02-hd' and 'speech-02-turbo'.
speech-02-hd is optimized for high-fidelity applications like voiceovers and audiobooks.
speech-02-turbo is designed for real-time applications with low latency.

@default "speech-02-turbo"

emotion.description:
The emotion to use for the voice. If not provided, will use auto-detect mode.
Options include: 'happy', 'sad', 'angry', 'fearful', 'surprised', 'disgusted', 'neutral'

subtitleType.description:
Controls the granularity of subtitle/timing data returned by Minimax
during synthesis. Set to 'word' to receive per-word timestamps in
assistant.speechStarted events for karaoke-style caption rendering.

@default "sentence"

pitch.description:
Voice pitch adjustment. Range from -12 to 12 semitones.
@default 0

speed.description:
Voice speed adjustment. Range from 0.5 to 2.0.
@default 1.0

volume.description:
Voice volume adjustment. Range from 0.5 to 2.0.
@default 1.0

region.description: The region for Minimax API. Defaults to "worldwide".

languageBoost.description: Language hint for MiniMax T2A. Example: yue (Cantonese), zh (Chinese), en (English).

textNormalizationEnabled.description: Enable MiniMax text normalization to improve number reading and formatting.

chunkPlan.description: This is the plan for chunking the model output before it is sent to the voice provider.

fallbackPlan.description: This is the plan for voice provider fallbacks in the event that the primary voice provider fails.
